item: The backup manifest is read only from a regular file, volume names are full matches, merged backups skip the key try
refs: PR #2072; Lane F security read of the import PRs, planner item c
summary: Three hardening follow-ups from the security read of the import PRs. load_manifest reads the volume manifest only when it is a regular file (never a link, a FIFO or a device; lstat, O_NOFOLLOW, O_NONBLOCK, fstat re-check) and at most 256 MiB, so a planted /dev/zero link or a FIFO cannot fill memory or hang the import. Volume file names are matched whole (a trailing newline no longer passes) and . and .. are refused. The early wrong-passphrase check skips a backup already merged, so one merged backup under an old passphrase no longer refuses a whole batch.
